faq.heading: FAQ
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before you create your StoryWall.
items: StoryWall is your event’s private online space for information, photos, videos, posts, reactions, wishes, and memories before, during, and after the big day.
Do guests need to download an app?
No. Guests open StoryWall in their browser through your event link or QR code. Nothing to install.
Can guests share photos and videos?
Yes. Guests can add their own photos, videos, and moments so everything comes together in one place.
No, and that is the beauty of it. The photographer captures the big moments. StoryWall keeps the backstage, the spontaneous videos, the reactions, and the memories seen by your guests.
Can I use StoryWall before the event?
Of course. Start early with announcements, schedules, RSVPs, countdowns, preparation photos, and posts that build the excitement.
The story does not end when the event does. Keep sharing photos, videos, wishes, next-day moments, honeymoon memories, and thank-you posts.
Can I make it fit my event?
Yes. Shape StoryWall around the style and feeling of your event so it feels like part of the experience.
What kinds of events work with StoryWall?
Weddings, baptisms, gender reveals, baby showers, birthdays, anniversaries, VIP parties, conferences, launches, and any occasion worth remembering.
Can I manage the content and guest activity?
Yes. As the host, you can keep an eye on participation, content, and the main parts of your event from one place.
How can I see if StoryWall is right for me?
Open the demo and experience it for yourself. Explore the space, the main features, and the way guests share the story.
